svg.title: Progressive rollout with halt gates
svg.desc: A three by three grid. Exposure (how many are reached) runs left to right in three steps. Capability (what the system may do) runs bottom to top in three steps. A staircase path through five numbered cells moves one axis at a time, with a gate before every step. Each gate needs seven checks and an explicit pass. Any check not passed sends the release down a halt path: investigate, roll back, remediate, retest, then back to the gate. Entry is deployment approved (8.4). Exit is full rollout on both axes, or a halted stage with the halt criterion named.
